parameters.name: github_url
parameters.description: Base URL of the GitHub API. Default: "https://api.github.com"

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate to GitHub with.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description: Full name of the repository to configure a hook for.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token to authenticate to GitHub with.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User to authenticate to GitHub as.

examples:
- name: List hooks for a repository (password auth)
  community.general.github_webhook_info:
    repository: ansible/ansible
    user: "{{ github_user }}"
    password: "{{ github_password }}"
  register: ansible_webhooks

- name: List hooks for a repository on GitHub Enterprise (token auth)
  community.general.github_webhook_info:
    repository: myorg/myrepo
    user: "{{ github_user }}"
    token: "{{ github_user_api_token }}"
    github_url: https://github.example.com/api/v3/
  register: myrepo_webhooks

return_values.name: hooks
return_values.description: A list of hooks that exist for the repo. Returned: always Sample: [{"active": true, "content_type": "json", "events": ["issue_comment", "pull_request"], "has_shared_secret": true, "id": 6206, "insecure_ssl": "1", "last_response": {"code": 200, "message": "OK", "status": "active"}, "url": "https://jenkins.example.com/ghprbhook/"}]
